title: Eject a CD or DVD
summary: Eject a physical CD or DVD from the optical drive. This command unmounts the volume and physically ejects the disc.

steps.explain: Eject the CD or DVD located at the specified disk identifier. Replace <DISK> with the identifier of the optical drive (e.g., /dev/disk3).

placeholders.name: DISK
placeholders.description: The disk identifier of the optical drive, e.g., /dev/disk3

steps.expect: The disc is physically ejected from the drive.
